name: Pastor Godspower Opara Martins
title: Lead Pastor, TFCG
imageAlt: Pastor Godspower Opara Martins ministering at The Faith Centre Global
bio: Pastor Godspower is an anointed teacher of the Word, operating heavily in the prophetic and apostolic offices. With a divine mandate to liberate men from the shackles of darkness, his ministry is characterized by deep scriptural insights, accurate prophetic declarations, and notable miracles.
He is passionate about raising a congregation of believers who not only know the Word but demonstrate its power in their everyday lives.
